messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف معلومات غير موجودة، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON فقط وفق الشكل: {"book_code":"TADAM","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"..."}]}. أخرج وحدة واحدة لكل مدخل بالترتيب. إذا كان مرجع المصدر مجمّعاً مثل 1,2 فترجم نصه مرة واحدة واجعل verse أول رقم فقط، ولا تقسّمه إلى وحدتين.

{"book_code":"TADAM","units":[{"chapter":48,"source_ref":"48:5","text":"And all the 'powers' of angels marched before Adam, and the sleep of the dead was"},{"chapter":48,"source_ref":"48:6","text":"consecrated. And the angels Michael and Uriel buried Adam and Abel in the parts of Paradise, before the eyes of Seth and his mother"},{"chapter":48,"source_ref":"48:7","text":"[and no one else], and Michael and Uriel said: 'Just as ye have seen, in like manner, bury your dead.'"},{"chapter":49,"source_ref":"49:1","text":"Six days after, Adam died; and Eve perceived that she would die, (so) she assembled all her sons"},{"chapter":49,"source_ref":"49:2","text":"and daughters, Seth with thirty brothers and thirty sisters, and Eve said to all, 'Hear me, my children, and I will tell you what the archangel Michael said to us when I and your father transgressed the command of God"}]}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return one item per input unit, in input order, using the first printed number when a source label is grouped: 48:5, 48:6, 48:7, 49:1, 49:2.
